title: Driveway Appeal: Esteban challenges access ruling and £135,000 costs; judges reserve decision
summary_full: A drawn-out legal conflict over driveway rights in Wales has escalated into a £135,000 court battle between neighbors. Carol Esteban is contesting a High Court decision that affirmed Neil and Nadine Gould's access to their parking space. The roots of the dispute go back to a 1949 property deal and a 1964 access document that lacked precision.
